data.one_liner: Carousel slider widget with infinite scroll, auto play, and custom child support
data.what_it_does: Provides a horizontally or vertically scrollable carousel of widgets. Supports infinite looping, auto‑play, custom indicators, and a controller for programmatic navigation.
use_when: You need a simple image or content carousel
You want auto‑play or infinite scrolling
You need a controller to jump or animate to pages
avoid_when: You require complex state management beyond the carousel
You need a highly custom animation that the widget does not expose
weaknesses: Requires manual disposal of controller for memory leaks
data.minimal_example:
CarouselSlider(
  options: CarouselOptions(height: 400.0, autoPlay: true),
  items: [1,2,3,4,5].map((i) => Builder(builder: (context) => Container(width: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width, margin: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5.0), color: Colors.amber, child: Text('text $i')))).toList(),
)
